qa.title: Q1237 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: If there are fewer than 10 Academic cards in my cemetery, can I still choose (2) and draw 2 cards?
qa.answer: No. You can still choose (2) as long as you can select an enemy leader or enemy follower on the field and pay 3 play points, but nothing will happen.

qa.title: Q1222 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: When resolving this spell's (2) effect, does the spell itself count toward the condition "if there are at least 10 Academic cards in your cemetery"?
qa.answer: No. While you're resolving this spell's effects, it isn't in the cemetery yet.

qa.title: Q1220 (Apr. 4, 2025)
qa.question: If I have at least 5 Academic cards in my cemetery and an evolved Grea, Mysterian Dragoness on my field, does Grea's Ember deal 4 damage?
qa.answer: Yes. Its damage first becomes 3 from its own replacement effect, then gets increased by 1 by Grea's ability.
